evidenceBoundary.exact: Selected inherited member order and original-span four-member NotNextCheckAction storage with its extended union tag. CheckSkillCastId has exactly four inherited source operands; its explicit buffered primitive programs and inherited setters prove the reader/ref-wrapper/owned base Data transfer and cursor accounting. SkillAffix has its own current route/source and four independently validated inherited buffered primitive/cursor/base-Data transfers; no extra serialized affix identifier is present. CheckDamageType joins its independently checked five-member current reader, generated setters and current dispatcher route; the final DamageType operand is a raw four-byte scalar.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Independently authenticated named nonrecursive action fields, including the inherited four-member prefix and scalar/byte suffixes. Source reader, generated setters/runtime fields and the selected action dispatcher must each agree. CheckSquadInFight independently names four inherited fields and its stored invertCondition byte. TriggerSpellBurstEventAction independently stores the four inherited operands followed by the spellBurstType DWORD.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Exact storage requires source digest, selected native inputs, reviewed member-count/null-wrapper framing and exact original span. Buffered helper paths and ordinary child returns preserving Win64 nonvolatile registers are required; source Boolean bits are retained independently of the normalized value passed to the setter.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Enum and flag meanings, evaluated predicates, IFix paths, provider selection, environment ownership and gameplay execution. An inherited-only action does not establish a no-op; a stored flag does not establish pause or event delivery. A stored invertCondition byte does not prove the selected fight-state receiver, predicate inversion, returned condition or execution. MoveGait stores maxGait before minGait; neither raw enum proves the evaluated movement limit or gait change. CheckSkillCastId has no additional serialized skill ID field. Live condition context, acquired cast identities, comparison result and condition execution remain unproved. Live skill-affix lookup/selection, handler effects and surrounding root admission remain unresolved. The spellBurstType bits do not prove an emitted spell-burst event or its receiver and effects. Stored DamageType values do not establish condition evaluation, a selected damage event, or any runtime branch effect.
